leadText: Fumiko Orikasa (Japanese: 折笠富美子 Orikasa Fumiko) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Fumiko Orikasa (Japanese: 折笠富美子 Orikasa Fumiko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Orikasa was born on December 27, 1974, in , , and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She became well-known for her roles in various anime series. Orikasa started her work on during the by voicing various characters of the day. In the fifth movie, she played the role of . However, her most prominent role was the Kalos League Champion Diantha. As a voice actress, Orikasa is currently affiliated with Atomic Monkey, while she is affiliated with Geneon Entertainment as a singer.
